description: Connect AI works with cloud data warehouses, relational databases, data lakehouses, analytics platforms and more so you can explore and analyze your data through conversation. Use your data as input to the work you're doing in ChatGPT, like correlating product telemetry with the release schedule to investigate user engagement. In Connect AI, you build virtual datasets across sources with defined relationships and semantic context, and surface them as purpose-built tools – so ChatGPT works with your data the way your business understands it, not just the way it’s stored. IT admins control access and monitor every query with full audit trails — so the right people reach the right data, nothing more.
